knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A usable entry names one hazard, the task and place, the people affected and the harm path.
Unknown items are not handled. The walk stops for that location and the site contact is told.
Hazards outside the scope are referred and recorded, and access is gained through the site contact.

practicalCriteria: Writes the scope with included areas, tasks and exclusions before the walk starts
Walks the site in a fixed order and records the route
Writes at least one entry in the one-hazard format with task, place, people affected, harm path and existing controls
Refers an out-of-scope hazard to the site contact and records the referral
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: An unknown item is found and the learner handles it rather than stopping and reporting
The learner enters a restricted area without the site contact
